title: CTI_WOUND: Panel-Bound Discoverability Scar — Lee Sharks / Pearl and Other Poems Evidence Packet, with Horizon-Privatization Note
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A CTI WOUND forensic evidence packet documenting a source-reported June 4, 2026 configuration across Google surfaces. The packet reports that a *Pearl and Other Poems* Knowledge Panel and its Google Books source seam remained reachable, while direct exact-match Google Books search did not retrieve the same object; the prior Lee Sharks author panel appeared absent; and AI Mode returned Mary Lee, the OCEARCH shark, for the authorial query.

The paper calls this **panel-bound discoverability scar**: object persistence inside a platform-controlled entity seam combined with ordinary discovery failure and AI-layer entity replacement. Sections 1–7 present the reported exhibit sequence. Section 8 separately registers incognito AI-surface disablement as an observed operational condition and **horizon privatization** as a preregistered, falsifiable interpretation rather than an established account of platform intent.
